segments.speaker: A. Rashid
segments.text: Good afternoon. Item one is the matters arising from the August meeting.

segments.speaker: N. Sultan
segments.text: Action MC-0812 on the data platform migration is closed; the report was circulated on Monday.

segments.speaker: A. Rashid
segments.text: Noted. Item two, the GPU business case, paper MC-2026-14, presented by F. Khalid.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: The request is BHD 250,000 for the first phase, with a second phase of BHD 400,000 next year subject to outcomes.

segments.speaker: H. Qassim
segments.text: Finance can fund the first phase from the approved technology budget; the second phase needs a separate paper.

segments.speaker: M. Darwish
segments.text: Risk is comfortable provided the hardware stays inside our own data centre.

segments.speaker: A. Rashid
segments.text: Then we approve phase one at BHD 250,000, and phase two returns as a separate paper in the first quarter.

segments.speaker: A. Rashid
segments.text: Item three, the notetaker pilot. F. Khalid, one sentence please.

segments.speaker: F. Khalid
segments.text: The pilot runs on internal meetings with volunteers; nothing leaves our devices.

segments.speaker: M. Darwish
segments.text: We should inform the Board about the pilot at the next quarterly review, as an information item.

segments.speaker: A. Rashid
segments.text: Agreed. N. Sultan, please add it to the Board pack for October.

segments.speaker: N. Sultan
segments.text: Will do, by the tenth of October.

segments.speaker: A. Rashid
segments.text: Any other business? None. We close the meeting.
